title: unable to merge to iceberg table with timestamp column after casting column to timestamp using spark
question:
I have a dataframe with columns that are timestamps, the data is read from a parquet file where the columns in question are definitely strings, but i have looked at each one and they are are "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss".

I then transform them to timestamps below

df = df.withColumn('datetime_creation_1', to_timestamp(trim(col("datetime_creation")), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")) \
    .withColumn('datetime_edited_1', to_timestamp(trim(col("datetime_edited")), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"))
df = df.drop('datetime_creation', 'datetime_edited')
df = df.withColumnRenamed('datetime_creation_1', 'datetime_creation') \
    .withColumnRenamed('datetime_edited_1', 'datetime_edited')
df.printSchema() # note: this shows the columes correctly as timestamp

update_schema_table(df, table, match_condition)

I then attempt to merge them to a iceberg table like so:

def update_schema_table(df: DataFrame, table: str, match_condition: str):
    df = df.withColumn('bronze_last_updated_time', current_timestamp())
    df.createOrReplaceTempView(f'incremental_{table}')
    merge_query = f"""
                        MERGE INTO {schema_util.catalog_name}.{schema_util.schema_name}.{table} AS bronze
                        USING incremental_{table} AS inc
                        ON bronze.{schema_util.primary_keys[table]} = inc.{schema_util.primary_keys[table]}
                        WHEN MATCHED {match_condition} THEN 
                           UPDATE SET *
                        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN 
                           INSERT ({','.join(df.columns)})
                           VALUES ({','.join(schema_util.table_columns[table])})
                    """
    logger.info(merge_query)
    spark.sql(merge_query)
    changelog_util.update_postgres_change_log(schema_util.primary_keys[table])

however I get this error:

pyspark.errors.exceptions.captured.AnalysisException: [INCOMPATIBLE_DATA_FOR_TABLE.CANNOT_SAFELY_CAST] Cannot write incompatible data for the table ``: Cannot safely cast `datetime_creation` "STRING" to "TIMESTAMP".

can anyone explain?
answer:
It turns out the issue was in the insert, specifically here:

INSERT ({','.join(df.columns)})
VALUES ({','.join(schema_util.table_columns[table])})

df.columns and schema_util.table_columns[table] was not the same. So I think it was indeed trying to insert a string into the timestamp columns, and strings that where not in timestamp format.

In my case the actual solution was just to sort the lists so they are the same:

INSERT ({','.join(sorted(df.columns))})
VALUES ({','.join(sorted(schema_util.table_columns[table]))})
